title: Maximum Subarray With Equal Products
summary: Given an array of positive integers, find the length of the longest subarray where the product of its elements equals the LCM of its elements multiplied by the GCD of its elements.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, find the length of the longest subarray where the product of its elements equals the LCM of its elements multiplied by the GCD of its elements.
constraints: For a contiguous subarray, compare its product with its GCD multiplied by its LCM.
Return the longest length for which those quantities are equal.
hints: The required quantities can be updated incrementally as a right endpoint grows.
Enumerate each left endpoint while maintaining product, GCD, and LCM.
Multiply the next value, update gcd/lcm, and record the length whenever product equals their product.
Every subarray appears once under its left and right endpoints, and the maintained aggregates are exact.
editorial: Every subarray appears once under its left and right endpoints, and the maintained aggregates are exact.

tests.explanation: A length-five subarray attains product equal to GCD times LCM.
Product six equals gcd one times lcm six, so both elements qualify.
